A Unique Theme Park

独特的主题公园 · 162 词 · 4 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1As soon as our shuttle got close to the theme park by the freeway, everyone came to life and put on their canvas sneakers for the outing. Our interpreter paid the admission fee, and we started enjoying the various attractions in the sunlight.

2According to the travel brochure, this unique park is famous for its well-preserved ethnic minority culture. We tried activities practised by early settlers, such as swinging across rivers, hunting creatures in the jungle, or taking part in sword-fighting tournaments.

3This park is also famous for its wooden souvenirs. Everything we bought in the central shop was made of wood, and wherever we went we could see minority carpenters working. They made wooden tools, wooden cartoon figures and wooden athletic equipment. They even built a huge wooden engine that measured 20 metres in length, which was modeled after a real one.

4This theme park is really a fantasy-themed amusement park. No wonder it has become a symbol of local tourism.

高考英语3500词 · 20中文译文

独特的主题公园

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1我们的接驳车刚靠近高速公路旁的主题公园，大家就来了精神，提前换上布面运动鞋，准备出游。随行翻译付了门票钱，我们就在阳光下逛起了各处景点。

2旅游手册上说，这座独特的公园以保存完好的少数民族文化闻名。我们体验了早期拓荒者做的许多事，比如荡过河去、在丛林里猎取动物，或参加剑术比赛。

3公园的木制纪念品也很有名。我们在中心商店买的东西都是木头做的，走到哪里都能看见少数民族木匠在工作。他们做木制工具、卡通人偶和体育用品等等，甚至还照着一台真正的发动机，造了一台二十米长的巨型木制发动机。

4这座主题公园真像一座奇幻的游乐场。难怪它成了当地旅游的一块招牌。
